title: Choose the visual world
question: Homepage first viewport for World Champion Taekwondo Washougal. Students in the hero. School mark in the header. Foundation mark in the footer. Trust first — no carnival offer scream.

options.label: Dobok Embroidery
options.lineage: Dobok V-neck tape, black-belt gold thread, cotton weave
options.thesis: The school reads as a uniform: cloth, rank thread, and three students holding one stance.
options.viewport: Full-bleed enhanced student hero; headline sits on the belt line; red tape is the only CTA.
options.risk: Can look like a uniform shop if the photo and credentials go quiet.

raised.raise: Rank stages read as dated bands — time made visible, never jars.
One axial sightline from chrome through the students, not a card grid.
Black collar trim grows in from the margins; the thesis sits in a clearing.
The three students are one coordinated row, like needles on the same downbeat.
The photo owns the whole first viewport as a living field; type stays thin over it.

options.label: Belt Rank Board
options.lineage: Dojang belt rack and painted wall type
options.thesis: Parents already read this school on a child’s waist — the page is that rack.
options.viewport: A hanging rank board structures the fold; students occupy today’s slot.
options.risk: Also the direction most TKD sites land on if the belts become clipart.

options.label: Dojang Portal
options.thesis: The dojang is a living field of pixels; chrome floats as thin type at the edges.
options.viewport: Students fill the screen; school name and one action sit in the margins.
options.case: Parents identify with the real mat; the offer can hide if type gets too thin.
options.risk: Reads as a film title card if the next step is not obvious.

options.label: Certificate Clearing
options.lineage: Secession page: ornament grows inward around a clearing
options.thesis: Master’s credentials sit in a formal clearing; trim grows in like a dobok collar.
options.viewport: Ornamented margins; students and Master occupy the center clearing.
options.case: Makes the school feel institutional and serious; weaker on kid-energy identification.
options.risk: Can read as a diploma mill poster if the kids disappear.

options.label: Maturation Calendar
options.thesis: Programs as staged batches that mature over time.
options.viewport: A seasonal shelf of program vessels.
options.case: Parents do not identify with fermentation; the school becomes a pantry.
options.kept: Dated stage bands so rank and time stay visible.

options.label: Axial Dojang
options.thesis: One ceremonial axis from the door to the students.
options.viewport: A palace-axis walk into the school.
options.case: Washougal parents do not live in a garden court; power-spectacle fights family trust.
options.kept: One axial sightline instead of a card grid.

options.label: Catalogue Spread
options.thesis: Programs packed edge to edge with price flashes.
options.viewport: A packed field of program cells and bursts.
options.case: Carnival pricing violates trust-first and Master-presentable tone.
options.kept: A dense, scannable program field — without bursts.

options.label: Meter Bridge
options.thesis: Class energy as a row of needles leaning together.
options.viewport: A desk of meters standing in for students.
options.case: Reads as audio gear, not a family dojang.
options.kept: Three students as one coordinated downbeat.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished martial-arts marketing page: photo, proof, programs, red button.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a parent already expects, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other academy site by design.
